name: Girls Literacy Promotion Scheme for Class 11th
nodalDept: Department of De-notified, Nomadic and Semi-nomadic Welfare Department
briefDescription: The "Girls Literacy Promotion Scheme Class 11th" by the Madhya Pradesh Government encourages girls from De-notified, Nomadic, and Semi-Nomadic communities to study. Girls enrolling in Class 11 for the first time receive ₹3,000/-
descriptionMd: The "Girls Literacy Promotion Scheme Class 11th" by the Department of De-notified, Nomadic, and Semi-Nomadic Welfare, Government of Madhya Pradesh, aims to encourage girls from De-notified, Nomadic, and Semi-Nomadic communities to pursue education. Under this scheme, an incentive amount of ₹3,000 is provided to girls enrolling in Class 11 for the first time. The scholarship distribution is managed through the Directorate of Public Distribution, Government of Madhya Pradesh.
eligibilityMd:
1. The applicant should be from Denotified, Nomadic, or Semi-Nomadic Community.
1. The applicant should be a girl.
1. The applicant should be enrolled in the 11th Standard.
1. The applicant should be studying in a recognized institution.
1. The applicant should have studied continuously without any academic breaks.
applicationMd:
> **Registration**

**Step 1:** Visit the "[Samarth Portal](https://samarth.mp.gov.in/Default)".
**Step 2:** Navigate to the top right corner of the homepage and click "[Registration".](https://samarth.mp.gov.in/Registration/Default)
**Step 3:** On the registration page, provide the mandatory details. (the fields marked with * are mandatory). If required, verify your Mobile Number and/or Email ID via OTP. Finally, click "Register".
> **Application**

**Step 1:** Visit the "[Samarth Portal](https://samarth.mp.gov.in/Default)".
**Step 2:****** Use the credentials you created during registration to log in.
**Step 3:****** Navigate to the online application form of the scheme you intend to apply for.
**Step 4:****** In the application form, fill in all the mandatory fields and upload all the mandatory documents in the specified format and size.
**Step 5:****** Carefully review all the information provided. Make any necessary corrections.
**Step 6:****** Acknowledge and agree to the terms and conditions, declaration, and privacy policy (if any).
**Step 7:****** Click the "Submit" to submit your application.
